title: NTP exporter - Agent
description: Clock accuracy of every node, with the optional kernel clock state and chronyd report.

panels.title: Error bound violations
panels.description: Nodes whose time daemon announces a maximum error smaller than the measured offset.

panels.title: Node clock offset (consensus of the servers)
panels.description: Offset of each node clock: consensus of the servers when 3 or more are configured, worst server offset otherwise.

panels.title: Error bound announced by the kernel
panels.description: maxerror is the guaranteed bound, esterror the estimate (dashboard only).

panels.title: Error bound violations (esterror shown for early detection)
chronyd tracking
panels.description: Source selected by chronyd on each node (like chronyc tracking).

panels.title: chronyd offset vs measured offset
panels.description: What chronyd believes against what the exporter measures from the outside. The measured offset is negated to share the sign convention of chronyd.

panels.title: chronyd root distance
panels.description: Root delay / 2 + root dispersion: error bound of the local clock announced by chronyd.

panels.title: Servers
panels.description: Last cycle per server. offset and rtt come from the sample with the lowest delay.

panels.title: Jitter (RFC 5905)
panels.description: RMS of the offset differences between the lowest-delay sample and the others.

panels.title: Root distance
panels.description: Upper bound of the error of the server time (RFC 5905 synchronization distance).

panels.title: Reference age
panels.description: Time since the server clock was last set or corrected.

panels.title: NTS key exchange
panels.description: Result of the last NTS-KE (TLS, port 4460), expiry of its certificate and NTP server negotiated by the key exchange. The key exchange runs again every hour.
